The other mathematical pieces (`openZeroExtension_*`, `real_chart_gradient_memLp`, `quotientPlaneRepresentative_plane`) are already factored into lemmas that the target calls. I am not aware of any residual uncertainty beyond the helper lemmas, which I did not read in full.
